test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some tablets are mobile phones

All mobile phones are telephones

Some laptops are tablets

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some laptops are mobile phones

(II) Some telephones are laptops

(III) All tablets are telephones

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b3fc6776ed24370baa793f815abcd01184e6fd12ff2e60b6c841025dc097d5d.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some laptops are mobile phones - FALSE (Because there is no definite relation given between laptop and mobile phones it is a possible case only)

(II) Some telephones are laptops - FALSE (Because no definite relation is given between telephones and laptop it is a possible case only)

(III) All tablets are telephones - FALSE (Because, all mobile is laptop and some tablet is telephone is given in the statement and all mobile is telephone is a possibility but not definite)

So,** 'None of the conclusions follows'**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
